## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4181cc240213dfbc224d5096a1041787b608b901`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs, scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, AGENTS.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md

Inputs: card #29665 (body + all four comments, the amendment 6592303181 and the claim 6592492414 included), PR #29695's body, file list and net diff against the merge base 2ea60422 (10 files, +125/−28, equal to the file list), and the 46 check-runs on the head: 30 `success`, 16 `skipped` by path filter, 0 failed, 0 in progress. Of the ten required contexts, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Test UI` are `success`; `Build Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI` and `Live E2E UI` are path-skipped, the expected state for a diff that touches no package. The os-dev report comments were read as claims and tested against the tree; nothing below rests on them. The rest of the diff (the five `scripts/pm/**` files) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`, read here as cited code only.

### ① Derived judgments

- Seat signature admits `security#N` — `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (check-half-states.mjs:1282) and its mirror `SIGNATURE_LINE` (fleet-roster.mjs:300) each gain one alternative; the fleet-roster self-test holds the two byte-equal, so every write door (`post-stamped`, `issue-create`, `label-write`) accepts the seat's first line. **Right.**
- Seat key admits the bare lane `security` — `SEAT_BARE_LANES` (mailbox-open.mjs:187) is the ONE list `SEAT_SHAPE` and `RESERVED_DOMAIN_LANE` are built from, so the one word makes `security#1` a key (`security#1`, slug `security-1`), `security` alone seat 1, and reserves `domain:security`; the `To:` line (record-recognisers.mjs:1482) and every `LANE#N` field read through `seatKey`, so the doorbell and the mailbox follow. **Right.** Self-test rows pin all four readings and the ONE-list string.
- Mailbox vocabulary gains `notify:security`, 14 → 15 — reader accepts exactly two parts and the id alone; `ADVISORY_ID_REF` is `/^GHSA(-[0-9a-z]{4}){3}$/`, byte-equal to the relay's `GHSA_ID_SHAPE` (fleet-write/ops.mjs:932) and held equal by a self-test row; `numbers` is empty so no card is ever read off it. Seven refusal variants pinned (free text, a path, a second field, a card number, upper-case, short, no id). **Right** — this is the ruling's 「opaque id only」 made mechanical.
- Line ratchet: four rows raised or added at the landed counts, `lanes/security.md` added to `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES`; `laneRosterVerdict` (check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:3246) reds any `lanes/*.md` without a row, so the row is required, not optional. **Right.**
- Seat-post readers unchanged and sufficient: `seatLane` (check-half-states.mjs:7747) reads `[PM seat] security#1 — 🟢 login` as a lane-less seat (`lane: null, foreign: true`), the same silent direction as `skills` and `triage`; H5's sticker check reads the holder. No reader needs a `security` word. **Right.**
- No label, no gate, no patrol row, nothing published; `--mailbox-keys` output gains two lines. **Right.**
- Pre-existing, not introduced here, named so nobody reads it as new: `domain:security#1 · …` still reads as a signature through the `domain:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*` arm while `seatKey` now refuses it — the same gap already holds for `domain:triage` and `domain:director`.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` ship in no released package, so nothing publishes; `Check Changeset` is path-skipped on the head. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body are right — no authorable key, value or type moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Surface addition `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (dev deviation, both rounds): **answered** — `laneRosterVerdict` reds a new lane file without a `CEILINGS` row, so the gate the order required green cannot pass without the rows; data rows only; accepted.
- Round-1 open question (the third lane-grammar copy, options A/B): **answered by the patch round under A**, which the amendment ruling already decided (「有处理的规则需要写入skills」 plus the lane 「has a seat post and mailbox like every lane」); the edit is the one word plus header and self-test rows, read above. Round-2 `open_questions` is empty.
- `documentation` label on the PR, not set by the dev: another actor's; left as is — right.
- `Part of #29665`, not `Fixes`: right — Change 5 (the seat post) is the seating session's act.
- PR body not patched by the dev (listed under `pr_body_edits_owed`): the body still says the mailbox half 「waits on a file outside this PR's surface」 and reports tests at 3868301a. This review judged the tree, not the body; the seat owes those five edits before readying (should-fix on the PR record, not the tree).
- Out-of-scope finding (three copies of the lane grammar held in step by nothing but a header sentence; `coordinator` signs but cannot be addressed): **escalated as a card for `domain:skills`** — a self-test row holding `SEAT_BARE_LANES` as a subset of the signature alternation is the cheapest guard; not a blocker here.

### ④ Design judgment

**`SKILL.md`** — one 域车道 row, spelled from the amendment's 「security findings (no file surface; fixes land in the owning package via no-card orders)」; the first cell is not a label and no gate reads that column as one (only check-skill-line-ratchet reads the table, for bytes). The deleted 红线 「未经人工的发布痕迹按事故立案,不代跑补救性发布;机械通道存在不构成授权」 has three clauses and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #15 carries each, verbatim read on `main`: 「When you find a publish nobody ordered — a tag or an npm version that simply appeared — ⛔ do not "repair" it with a counter-publish: file it as an incident for the maintainer」 carries 立案 and 不代跑补救; 「The existence of a path to a release is not authorization to walk it, and the YAML is not a barrier that holds against you」 carries 机械通道不构成授权. AGENTS.md outranks SKILL.md (AGENTS.md line 6; SKILL.md 优先序 line 41) and the preceding 红线 still defers the release list there. Nothing lost. **Holds.**

**`lanes/security.md`** — against the maintainer's rulings, verbatim on the card: 「设 security#1 座位」 → 席位 `security#N`,首席 `security#1`; 「虽然你不需要打标签」 → 无 `domain:security` 标签、无 `pm:queue`、无文件面; the lane has a seat post and mailbox → 签名、座位贴、坐席与收班同他席 (seat-lifecycle.md:39 opens the mailbox at seating; `seatKey` now accepts it); the ledger → 不透明编号 · 会话 · 状态, five states, ⛔ 无细节 — the 会话 column is the claim-ledger half the maintainer approved with 「按建议办」 on comment 6592492414 (「opaque id + session + status」) and is not detail; hand-over → 台账与在飞公告留在座位贴,⛔ 不释放进 `pm:queue`. The text names no finding, advisory, path, object or mechanism. Two should-fix findings:
- **S1 (should-fix) — restatement beyond the card's ordered bullets.** The card's Change 2 orders the fix-order, review and §7 bullets, so those stand as handling rules each with its section pointer. Two lines go past that and copy never-public rules the charter's own line 4 promises not to copy: line 12 (读公告只经中继 `advisory_read`;建草稿与写公告只经中继,⛔ 永不以自身账号写) restates §3 lines 22 and 24; line 17's 「⛔ 不换账号重发」 restates §3 line 25. Replace each with a pointer to 第 3 节; §8 「一处成文」 is the reason — two copies drift.
- **S2 (should-fix) — the §7 hand-over has no instrument.** triage.md:16 and the charter's 误公开的卡 line say triage 转交 the seat, but no mailbox key carries a public card to `security#1` (`Notify: security` refuses a card number by design; 表外即半态, project-forms.md:6). Say which it is: the seat's patrol reads open `security`-labelled cards itself (so the label IS the hand-over), or triage builds the draft via the relay and rings `Notify: security` as the finder of record. One sentence in the charter's §7 line settles it.

**`lanes/triage.md`** — push ① unchanged; the two new lines are the ruling 「triage only pushes and hands over」: 转交 `security#1` 即止, grading only `security` + p1 on a public card, §7 handling while the seat is vacant, ⛔ 不代席. **Holds**, with S2 above applying to the word 转交.

**`project-forms.md`** — the `Notify: security` row is in the 〈信箱 PR〉 section, the section ↔ `MAILBOX_KEYS` bidirectional self-test pin holds at 15 keys, 安全发现 leaves the 不敲 list and the new line keeps 机制、路径、对象名 out. **Holds.** One should-fix in the cited row it mirrors:
- **S3 (should-fix) — `from` overreaches §5.** `MAILBOX_KEYS` row `notify:security` says `from: 'the finder — any seat, dev or QA runner'` (printed by `--mailbox-keys`), but a dev's finding goes only into the private `security_findings` field (os-dev.md:49; security-findings.md §5) and a runner's only to 派发它的 PM 会话 (checklist-test SKILL.md:266–267); the ringer is therefore the seat holding the finding, as the card says (「Any seat sends it to security#1」). Spell `from` as the seat holding the finding; the readers and self-tests do not change.

**`security-findings.md`** — §9 is Change 1 to the letter: owner from intake to publish, the finder's two acts (relay `advisory_create` draft; one `Notify: security · GHSA-ID` doorbell), the relay-refused fallback (seat, then maintainer), publish stays the maintainer's; §8's pointer list gains the security lane in place. No mechanism, no finding, no label, no gate. **Holds.** Every other pointer at this file on the head (filing-gate.md:15, lanes/server.md:52, rest-channel.md:50, os-dev.md:49, checklist-test SKILL.md:266) still only points.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: S1, S2, S3 — the seat may fold them into a patch on this claim or carry them as one `domain:skills` card; none changes a reader, a gate or a ruling.
